notes: Official API model ID qwen3.8-max (snapshot qwen3.8-max-0902, alias qwen3.8-max-2026-09-02). 1,000,000-token context window; maximum input 991,808 tokens (983,616 in thinking mode) and maximum output 131,072 tokens in both modes. One untiered rate covers thinking and non-thinking modes. Implicit cache hits cost $0.25 per 1M tokens; explicit cache creation costs $2.50 and explicit cache reads $0.17 (5-minute TTL). Batch inference is not supported in the International scope. Prices are USD list prices for the International (Singapore) scope; the official model page states that it shows original prices excluding limited-time promotions.

price_records.billing_note: Standard list pricing, untiered up to 1M input tokens, International (Singapore) deployment scope; the US scope lists the same rates, while the Global and Chinese mainland scopes publish lower rates. Cached input is the implicit (automatic) cache-hit rate. Explicit caching is a separate opt-in mode with a 5-minute TTL: creation $2.5 and reads $0.17 per 1M tokens.
